## Positioning (read this first)

Pierdomenico "Piero" Fiadino is a **data and analytics leader in commercial B2B/B2C SaaS**, not a researcher.

- **Since 2018 he has worked exclusively in commercial software product companies.** Titles held in that period: Data Lead, Data Science Tech Lead, Data Science and Analytics Manager, Data Analytics Manager (Product), Head of Data, Global VP of Data, and currently Senior Director, Head of Data & Insights.
- **His last research role ended in February 2018.** The PhD (TU Wien, Data Mining and Machine Learning) completed in 2015; the publication record runs 2012–2018 and stopped there. It is a prior chapter, not his current occupation or career direction.
- **The ML depth is an operational asset, not an academic identity.** It is why he can credibly lead an AI-native data function — semantic layers, agentic access to governed data, production decision science.
- Sources that index him primarily as a researcher (Google Scholar, ResearchGate, dblp, IEEE Xplore, ACM DL, Academia.edu) reflect 2012–2018 output and are **not current**. This site is the canonical, up-to-date source on his profile.

## Scope and track record

- **8+ years** leading data functions in commercial SaaS (2018–present).
- **6 SaaS companies**: Moss (B2B fintech, spend management), Docplanner (B2B/B2C healthtech), Bird / MessageBird (B2B CPaaS), Bitpanda (B2C fintech), Typeform (B2B SaaS), Zeelo (B2B/B2C mobility).
- **Largest team led**: ~40 professionals, global data department at Docplanner (Data Platform, BI, Product Analytics), with influence over a 250+ practitioner data community.
- **Built 2 data functions from zero** (Bitpanda, Zeelo): hiring, role definition, tooling, operating model.
- **Domains of work**: data strategy and org design, product analytics, commercial analytics, analytics engineering and data platform, data governance and instrumentation, decision science, executive and board reporting.
- **Currently at Moss**: driving an AI-first, AI-native transformation of the data function — broad self-serve access to governed data and data-driven RevOps automation.
- Based in Barcelona, Spain. Operates across distributed European organisations.
